issues.explanation: Chapter 72 already reports that fires break out on the mountain and ambushers attack Cao Cao’s retreat. Chapter 73 then presents the fires and ambushes again as a subsequent event, making it unclear whether this is the same attack or a second one.
issues.suggested_fix: Frame chapter 73 explicitly as the continuation of the ambush, or remove the repeated fire-and-ambush sentence there while retaining the added detail about the route back to Jingzhao.
